_readme: stock kit generation record (task A, 2026-08-17/18): 14 cover paintings + 11 six-cell sheets = 66 cut-outs, gouache illustrated style, style_anchor and prompt skeletons from ../manifest.json (japan-cover-hero / japan-sheet-cutouts-a). PNG masters stay out of git; `files` lists the webp that ship. Lookup table: index.json; how-to: README.md.

assets.name: stock-sheet-landmark-a
assets.prompt: A sheet of SIX separate flat hand-drawn travel illustrations arranged in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid on a plain pure white background, WIDE empty white gutters between every illustration and a wide white margin around the grid, each one a single isolated subject with a thick organic silhouette, no ground line and no shadow, all sharing the same gouache paint texture with soft grain, warm muted palette of terracotta, sand beige, dusty teal and cream, clean rounded shapes, minimal cozy storybook style. Row 1: the Eiffel Tower in Paris, full height, iron lattice arch at the base; Tower Bridge in London with its two stone towers and a raised bascule deck; the Big Ben clock tower of Westminster with its gothic spire and clock face. Row 2: the Sagrada Familia in Barcelona with its tall pointed honeycomb spires; the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin: a wide colonnade topped by a chariot with four horses; Neuschwanstein castle: a white fairy-tale castle with slim blue-roofed towers on a wooded crag. No borders, no text, no watermark
